newsitem.title: USA: Compaq unveils new Armada 7300 computers.
newsitem.headline: Compaq unveils new Armada 7300 computers.

text.p: Compaq Computer Corp said Wednesday it unveiled a new Armada 7300 line of mobile notebook computers.
The Armada 7300 models should be available in August, the company said, at prices ranging from $4,399 to $4,899.

The standard features on the 7300 models include Pentium processors with MMX technology at speeds of up to 166-MHz, 2.1 Gigabyte (GB) hard drives, up to 32 Megabytes (MB) of random access memory (RAM) standard and video/graphics performance, the company said.
The new model, part of the Armada 7700 family, is about 1.5-inches thin and weighs about six pounds.
